apps.name: Brain Test
apps.tagline: Can your Tesla brain? A 20-second test of the car's computer, ranked against other Teslas, phones and PCs.

apps.name: Brick Breaker
apps.tagline: Classic paddle game. Drag to move, tap to launch.

apps.name: Fractal Explorer
apps.tagline: Multi-threaded WebAssembly Mandelbrot. Pinch to zoom.

apps.name: Sleep Sounds
apps.tagline: Rain, ocean, campfire and more for Camp Mode, with a dim clock and sleep timer.

apps.name: Campfire
apps.tagline: A crackling fire with sparks and crickets. Cozy screen for the campsite.

apps.name: Star Map
apps.tagline: What's in the sky tonight: stars, planets and the Moon over your campsite.

apps.name: Weather
apps.tagline: Forecast, sunset, true darkness, Moon and a stargazing rating for tonight.

apps.name: Satellite Tracker
apps.tagline: When to see the ISS, Hubble and new Starlink trains pass over you.

apps.name: Sky Events
apps.tagline: Meteor showers, full moons, eclipses and planets for the year ahead, and what is up tonight.

apps.name: What's Around Me
apps.tagline: History, landmarks and nature near where you are parked, from Wikipedia. Great while charging.

apps.name: Pit Stop
apps.tagline: Restrooms, coffee, food and shops within walking distance of the charger, with what's open now.

apps.name: Speed Test
apps.tagline: How fast is the car's internet right now? Download, upload and ping, on Wi-Fi or LTE.

apps.name: Car Benchmark
apps.tagline: See what this car's browser can do.

apps.name: Tiny Games
apps.tagline: Nine free retro games on the TIC-80 fantasy console, plus any .tic carts you send from your phone. Touch or controller.

apps.name: Retro Console
apps.tagline: Play homebrew games, or NES, Game Boy, GBA, Master System and Game Gear games you own sent from your phone, with a controller or on screen.

apps.name: Holders
apps.tagline: Early access for FrunkStore token holders: Craft 4K, Freedoom, LibreQuake, OpenArena, OpenTTD, and Genesis and TurboGrafx-16 games, plus a vote on what's next. Unlock with your phone's wallet.

apps.name: Genesis & PC Engine
apps.tagline: Mega Drive / Genesis and TurboGrafx-16 games for FrunkStore token holders: free homebrew, or cartridges you own.

apps.name: Craft 4K
apps.tagline: Notch's tiny Minecraft4k rebuilt in C++ and ray-marched on the graphics chip: a big block world with sun shadows, day and night, and mirrors to build with.

apps.name: Freedoom
apps.tagline: The classic Doom engine with the free Freedoom games, or Doom games you own sent from your phone, with a controller or on screen.

apps.name: Blasphemer
apps.tagline: The Heretic engine with the free dark-fantasy game Blasphemer, or Heretic you own sent from your phone. Spells, relics and flight.

apps.name: LibreQuake
apps.tagline: The classic Quake engine with the free LibreQuake, or Quake you own sent from your phone, with a controller or on screen.

apps.name: OpenTTD
apps.tagline: Build a transport empire with trains, trucks, ships and planes. The open-source Transport Tycoon, made for touch.

apps.name: OpenArena
apps.tagline: Fast arena shooting against bots on the Quake III engine: a free game with ten arenas, on screen or with a controller.

apps.name: Block Builder
apps.tagline: Build anything in a Minecraft Classic-style world of blocks: creative mode, flying, and worlds that save as you play.

apps.name: Adventure Games
apps.tagline: Classic point-and-click adventures on ScummVM: seven free games, or ones you own sent from your phone.

apps.name: Text Adventures
apps.tagline: Zork I, II and III, the Infocom classics, now open source. Tap words to build commands, or type.

apps.name: Logic Puzzles
apps.tagline: Forty classic logic puzzles by Simon Tatham, from Solo (sudoku) to Mines and Net, with endless new boards in every size.

apps.name: Chess Puzzle
apps.tagline: Solve the Lichess daily chess puzzle on your screen.
